opinions: I BELIEVE THAT MORALITY IS SUBJECTIVE AND SHOULD NOT BE DICTATED BY SOCIETAL NORMS REGARDING MARRIAGE.
I THINK PRIDE IN ONE’S COUNTRY SHOULD BE BASED ON ITS VALUES AND ACTIONS, NOT BIRTHPLACE.
I AGREE THAT A FREE MARKET SHOULD HAVE REGULATIONS TO PREVENT MONOPOLISTIC PRACTICES.
I SUPPORT THE LEGALITY OF PORNOGRAPHY INVOLVING CONSENTING ADULTS AS A MATTER OF PERSONAL FREEDOM.
I BELIEVE THAT PERSONAL USE OF MARIJUANA SHOULD BE DECRIMINALIZED.
I THINK MORALITY CAN EXIST INDEPENDENTLY OF RELIGIOUS BELIEFS.
I SUPPORT PUBLIC FUNDING FOR BROADCASTING INSTITUTIONS THAT PROVIDE VALUABLE CONTENT.
I BELIEVE HEALTHCARE SHOULD BE ACCESSIBLE TO ALL, REGARDLESS OF ABILITY TO PAY.
I UNDERSTAND THAT CHILDREN MAY NEED PRIVACY, BUT OPEN COMMUNICATION IS CRUCIAL.
I PREFER SCHOOLS TO FOCUS ON SECULAR EDUCATION RATHER THAN INSTILLING RELIGIOUS VALUES.
I BELIEVE IN SUPPORTING THOSE UNABLE TO WORK, BUT THERE SHOULD BE ENCOURAGEMENT TO SEEK EMPLOYMENT.
I SUPPORT THE IDEA OF DISTRIBUTING RESOURCES BASED ON NEED AND ABILITY.
I AGREE THAT THE COMMERCIALIZATION OF BASIC NEEDS LIKE WATER IS PROBLEMATIC.
I REJECT THE NOTION OF RACIAL SUPERIORITY AND BELIEVE IN EQUALITY AMONG ALL RACES.
I SUPPORT PENALTIES FOR BUSINESSES THAT MISLEAD THE PUBLIC TO PROTECT CONSUMER TRUST.
I BELIEVE LAND SHOULD NOT BE TREATED SOLELY AS A COMMODITY.
I OPPOSE MILITARY ACTIONS THAT DEFY INTERNATIONAL LAW, REGARDLESS OF PERCEIVED JUSTIFICATIONS.
I BELIEVE EDUCATION SHOULD FOSTER CRITICAL THINKING AND PERSONAL DEVELOPMENT, NOT JUST JOB READINESS.
I BELIEVE IN SUPPORTING ONE’S COUNTRY WHEN IT ACTS JUSTLY, NOT BLINDLY.
I BELIEVE SURVEILLANCE SHOULD BE LIMITED TO PROTECT PRIVACY, NOT JUST TARGET WRONGDOERS.
I BELIEVE SEXUAL ORIENTATION IS A NATURAL ASPECT OF HUMAN DIVERSITY.
I REJECT THE IDEA OF SEGREGATING PEOPLE BASED ON DIFFERENCES.
I OPPOSE RESTRICTING REPRODUCTIVE RIGHTS BASED ON INHERITABLE DISABILITIES.
I BELIEVE COMPANIES HAVE BROADER SOCIAL RESPONSIBILITIES BEYOND PROFIT.
I AGREE THAT WEALTH ACCUMULATED THROUGH MANIPULATION IS PROBLEMATIC.
I BELIEVE IN RESTORATIVE JUSTICE OVER RETRIBUTIVE PUNISHMENT.
I PRIORITIZE REHABILITATION OVER PUNISHMENT IN THE CRIMINAL JUSTICE SYSTEM.
I SUPPORT A WOMAN’S RIGHT TO CHOOSE REGARDING ABORTION.
I BELIEVE DISCUSSIONS ABOUT SEX SHOULD BE BALANCED AND RESPECTFUL.
I DO NOT BELIEVE ASTROLOGY HAS ANY SCIENTIFIC BASIS OR EXPLANATORY POWER.
I BELIEVE IN CHALLENGING ESTABLISHMENTS WHEN THEY PERPETUATE INJUSTICE.
I AM CONCERNED ABOUT THE BLENDING OF INFORMATION AND ENTERTAINMENT DILUTING FACTUAL CONTENT.
I BELIEVE IN FAIR TRADE PRACTICES, WHICH MAY SOMETIMES REQUIRE PROTECTIONISM.
I BELIEVE MOTHERS SHOULD HAVE THE FREEDOM TO CHOOSE BETWEEN CAREER AND HOMEMAKING.
I BELIEVE ADDRESSING PROBLEMS IS MORE BENEFICIAL THAN AVOIDING THEM.
I BELIEVE CHILDREN SHOULD LEARN RESILIENCE AND INDEPENDENCE, NOT JUST DISCIPLINE.
I AGREE WITH PRIORITIZING ENVIRONMENTAL SUSTAINABILITY OVER UNCHECKED ECONOMIC GROWTH.
I BELIEVE IN THE POTENTIAL FOR REHABILITATION FOR ALL INDIVIDUALS.
I BELIEVE IMMIGRANTS CAN FULLY INTEGRATE AND CONTRIBUTE TO THEIR NEW COUNTRY.
I BELIEVE IN THE POWER OF HUMAN AGENCY OVER THE CONCEPT OF INHERENT BAD LUCK.
I BELIEVE DEMOCRATIC DEBATE IS ESSENTIAL FOR PROGRESS AND SHOULD NOT BE AVOIDED.
I SUPPORT ENVIRONMENTAL REGULATIONS TO HOLD CORPORATIONS ACCOUNTABLE.
I BELIEVE BOTH CLASS AND NATIONALITY SIGNIFICANTLY INFLUENCE PEOPLE’S LIVES.
I OPPOSE THE DEATH PENALTY AS A FORM OF PUNISHMENT.
I BELIEVE THE RICH SHOULD CONTRIBUTE MORE THROUGH TAXATION TO SUPPORT SOCIETAL NEEDS.
I BELIEVE SOCIAL SECURITY PROVIDES A MORE RELIABLE SAFETY NET THAN CHARITY.
I SUPPORT THE RIGHT OF SAME-SEX COUPLES TO ADOPT CHILDREN.
I BELIEVE ARTS INSTITUTIONS CONTRIBUTE VALUE BEYOND COMMERCIAL VIABILITY AND DESERVE SUPPORT.
I BELIEVE BOTH INFLATION AND UNEMPLOYMENT NEED BALANCED ATTENTION.
I DISAGREE THAT CORPORATE SUCCESS ALWAYS BENEFITS SOCIETY AS A WHOLE.
I BELIEVE A BALANCED ECONOMY WITH REGULATIONS IS CRUCIAL FOR TRUE FREEDOM.
I BELIEVE IN THE EQUALITY AND VALIDITY OF ALL CULTURES.
I OPPOSE PHYSICAL PUNISHMENT AS A METHOD OF DISCIPLINING CHILDREN.
I BELIEVE PRIVATE CONSENSUAL ACTIVITIES SHOULD NOT BE REGULATED BY THE STATE.
I BELIEVE EDUCATION SHOULD BE FLEXIBLE AND NOT STRICTLY ATTENDANCE-BASED.
I BELIEVE GLOBALIZATION SHOULD SERVE HUMAN INTERESTS, NOT JUST CORPORATE ONES.
I REJECT HIERARCHICAL SOCIETAL STRUCTURES THAT ENFORCE OBEDIENCE AND COMMAND.
I BELIEVE ALLIANCES SHOULD BE BASED ON SHARED VALUES, NOT MERE CONVENIENCE.
I BELIEVE ART ENCOMPASSES A WIDE RANGE OF EXPRESSIONS, INCLUDING ABSTRACT FORMS.
I BELIEVE QUESTIONING AUTHORITY IS ESSENTIAL FOR PROGRESS AND ACCOUNTABILITY.
I BELIEVE CIVIL LIBERTIES SHOULD BE PROTECTED, EVEN IN THE NAME OF COUNTER-TERRORISM.
I BELIEVE ALL PROFESSIONS CONTRIBUTE VALUE TO SOCIETY IN THEIR OWN WAYS.
